meta.name: competitive-intel-watch
meta.description: Scheduled delta monitoring against a prior competitive snapshot. Use when tracking competitors on a cadence: material shifts only, cited evidence, battle-card update flags, runs unattended.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定时追踪竞品动态，只推送实质性变化
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期跟踪竞品并自动生成战报
copy.tagline_en: Track competitors on a schedule, get only material changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor competitors regularly and auto-generate battle cards

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会定期对比上一份竞品快照，只报告有实质变化的内容（如定价、产品发布、高管变动等），并标注需要更新的战卡或定位文档。如果没有变化，也会明确告知。
howto.when: 当你提供上一份竞品快照并指定关注点（如定价变动）时触发。如果没有快照，它会先创建一份基线快照。

say.text: 对比上季度的竞品快照，告诉我实际变化。
say.note: Claude 会读取快照并搜索变化。

say.text: 设置月度竞品监控，战卡过时自动标记。
say.note: Claude 会按计划运行并输出更新标记。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will periodically compare against a prior competitive snapshot, reporting only material changes (e.g., pricing, launches, leadership moves) with evidence and flags for updating battle cards or positioning. An empty changelog is a valid result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a prior snapshot and optionally specify focus areas (e.g., pricing moves). Without a snapshot, it creates a baseline first.

say_en.text: Run this against last quarter's snapshot and tell me what actually changed.
say_en.note: Claude reads the snapshot and searches for changes.

say_en.text: Set up a monthly competitor watch that flags when our battle card goes stale.
say_en.note: Claude runs on schedule and outputs update flags.
